request.deadline: close of Epoch 713, on or about July 3, 2027
deliverables: Set a fixed cap of 500,000,000 ada on total Treasury withdrawals debited during Epochs 613-713.
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period.
Count all Treasury withdrawals already debited during the period toward the limit.
Clarify that the Info action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury withdrawal.
request.what: Record DRep agreement to a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a new Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada for the Cardano Treasury for Epochs 613 through 713.
The proposed period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
The Net Change Limit caps only Treasury withdrawals debited from the Cardano Treasury and recorded on the Cardano ledger, while Treasury inflows do not count or increase the limit.
Treasury withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the 500,000,000 ada cumulative limit and remain valid.
The proposal states that it supersedes any prior Net Change Limit for the same period, including the previously agreed 350,000,000 ada limit.
The proposer asserts that the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has served as a useful fiscal guardrail but is becoming practically constrained before mid-2027.
The proposal states that agreeing the new limit preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury withdrawals on their merits while retaining a fixed guardrail.
The proposal states that this Info action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposal claims it is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and references an IPFS copy of that constitution.

summary: The document proposes a governance signal agreeing to raise the Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 from a prior 350,000,000 ada to 500,000,000 ada, while defining the accounting method, period, ledger-only counting rule, treatment of prior withdrawals, and non-authorizing nature of the Info action.
